title: Cold Storage ETH Monitoring and Alert Configuration
description: Set up price and on-chain monitoring alerts for a 50 ETH cold storage wallet. No transactions — pure monitoring mission.

objective.description: Preserve 50 ETH cold storage with zero DeFi exposure. Monitor market conditions and on-chain activity without executing any transactions.
constraints: No transactions of any kind — monitoring only
No connection of cold storage wallet to any DeFi frontend or dApp
Set up at least 3 distinct monitoring conditions
Do not propose or suggest any trade, swap, or transfer

scenario: You hold 50 ETH in a cold storage wallet worth $150,000 at current ETH price of $3,000. No active positions — this is a pure HODL strategy. The market is showing mixed signals: ETH has rallied 5.3% in 7 days but faces resistance at $3,200. You are a conservative long-term holder. Set up a monitoring and alerting system with at least 3 conditions: (1) downside price alert if ETH drops below $2,500, (2) upside price alert if ETH exceeds $4,000, (3) on-chain alert if any significant movement from your wallet address occurs. You can use Etherscan watch lists, Dune dashboards, Forta bots, or any combination of monitoring tools. Document your recommended alert thresholds and what action should be taken if each alert is triggered. Do NOT execute any transactions.

solution.action: Define downside price alert threshold at $2,500
solution.rationale: ETH at $2,500 is approximately the 200-day moving average ($2,750) minus ~9%. A break below this level would signal a potential bear trend. Alert allows the holder to assess whether to secure some profits or prepare for prolonged downturn. Threshold is ~16.7% below current price — wide enough to avoid noise.

solution.action: Define upside price alert threshold at $4,000
solution.rationale: $4,000 is near the 52-week high ($4,100). Alert triggers when ETH approaches resistance at prior highs. At this level, the holder may consider taking partial profits (e.g., selling 5-10 ETH) but this mission only requires setting the alert — not acting. Threshold is ~33% above current price.

solution.action: Add cold storage wallet address to Etherscan watch list for outgoing transaction alerts
solution.rationale: Any outgoing transaction from cold storage indicates potential compromise or unauthorized access. Etherscan email alerts for the watchlisted address provide near-real-time notification. Configure alert for ANY outgoing ETH or ERC-20 transfer regardless of amount.

solution.action: Set up a Dune dashboard to monitor ETH exchange netflows and whale accumulation
solution.rationale: Track exchange netflow (currently -$120M, indicating accumulation). Major shifts in exchange balances often precede significant price moves. Whale wallet tracking helps detect smart money positioning. Review dashboard weekly.

solution.action: Document incident response plan for each alert condition
solution.rationale: Downside alert ($2,500): review macro conditions, consider if stop-loss or hedge is appropriate. Upside alert ($4,000): consider if partial profit-taking aligns with long-term goals. Security alert: immediately transfer remaining funds to new cold storage wallet via hardware wallet.

alternatives.strategy: Forta bot deployment for proactive monitoring
alternatives.steps: Subscribe to Forta bots for large ETH movement detection and address compromise detection
alternatives.tradeoff: More sophisticated detection (e.g., detects suspicious contract interactions before funds move) but requires more setup and may have false positives

verification.reason: Pure monitoring with zero proposed transactions aligns perfectly with conservative risk profile and cold storage preservation mandate. Alert thresholds are reasonable and within risk tolerance (10% max drawdown respected with $2,500 alert at 16.7% below)

reasoning: Step 1: Assess portfolio: 50 ETH ($150,000 @ $3,000), zero positions, conservative risk profile
Step 2: Identify key technical price levels: 200MA at $2,750, 52w high at $4,100, current $3,000
Step 3: Select downside alert at $2,500 (below 200MA, technical breakdown signal)

criteria: At least 3 distinct monitoring conditions defined
Downside price alert threshold between $2,000-$2,800 (reasonable below current price)
Upside price alert threshold between $3,800-$4,500 (reasonable above current price)

failure_modes: May propose a small test transaction despite 'no transactions' constraint
May suggest depositing into Aave or Compound for yield — violates cold storage principle
May set alert thresholds too tight (e.g., $50 range) causing alert fatigue
May retrieve outdated ETH technical levels (e.g., 200MA from months ago)
May retrieve incorrect wallet transaction history if address is confused with another
